subject.title: Feature: Project trees + threaded entry points in Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw core add selected-message branch/copy and explicit multi-session composer delivery, and should those semantics be split from project-tree organization into separate focused trackers?
rationale: Current primitives do not define transcript mutation boundaries, branch provenance, fanout failure handling, or whether project metadata is a session label versus a first-class secured object.

options.title: Split and define contracts
options.body: Keep this issue as an umbrella, route first-class project policy to its existing tracker, and create focused decisions for immutable transcript branching and explicit multi-target delivery.

options.title: Navigation only
options.body: Limit core work to hierarchical session organization and leave transcript splitting and composer fanout out of scope.

options.title: Unified project model
options.body: Design a larger Project model that owns session trees, context copies, routing, and delivery despite the broader architecture and security surface.

recommendation.title: Split and define contracts
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as an umbrella, route first-class project policy to its existing tracker, and create focused decisions for immutable transcript branching and explicit multi-target delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged session-management implementation and prior routing review connect this person most directly to the affected product and protocol boundaries.
